App(Object object)

Register Mini Program. Accepts an Object parameter that specifies the lifecycle callback of the Mini Program, etc.

App() must be called in app.js and must be called only once. Otherwise, there will be unintended consequences.

Parameter

Object object

Properties Type Mandatory or Not Description
onLaunch Function No Lifecycle Callback - Initializing the Listening Mini Program
onShow Function No Lifecycle Callback - Monitor Mini Program start or switch foreground
onHide Function No Lifecycle Callback - Monitoring Small Program Switching Backstage
onError Function No Error listening function
Other Any No Developers can add any function or data variable to the Object parameter, and use this to access the object parameter.

onLaunch(Object object)

Triggered when Mini Program initialization is complete, globally triggered only once.

onShow(Object object)

Triggered when the Mini Program is started or when the foreground is displayed from the background.

onHide()

Triggered when the Mini Program is started or when the foreground is displayed from the background.

onError(String error)

Triggered when a script error occurs in the Mini Program or an API invoking error occurs.

Sample Code

App({
  onLaunch (options) {
    // Do something initial when launch.
  },
  onShow (options) {
    // Do something when show.
  },
  onHide () {
    // Do something when hide.
  },
  onError (msg) {
    console.log(msg)
  },
  globalData: 'I am global data'
})

AppObject getApp()

The app instance that is globally unique has been obtained.

Sample Code

// other.js
var appInstance = getApp()
console.log(appInstance.globalData) // I am global data

Precautions

  • Do not call getApp() in a function defined in App() or before calling App. You can use this to obtain an app instance.
  • After obtaining an instance through getApp(), do not call the life cycle function.
